errors.text_span: Първият сектор, оцветен в синьо, представлява приблизително 0-5% от вложените материали, втория, оцветен в оранжево, 5-10%, третия, оцветен в жълто, 10-15%, четвъртият, в лилаво, 15-20% и последният, оцветен в зелено, „повече от 20%“.
errors.evidence: The description confuses the category labels from the legend with the actual percentage values of the pie slices. For example, the blue slice, which represents the category "0-5%", has a value of 33.3% of the total responses, but the description incorrectly states it represents "approximately 0-5%". This error is repeated for all slices, and the color-to-category mapping is also incorrect (e.g., the purple slice corresponds to ">20%", not "15-20%").

The description fails to report the actual percentage values that are explicitly written inside each pie slice (33.3%, 14.3%, 23.8%, 19%, 9.5%), even though the prompt requires describing the percentage if it is explicitly marked.
